title: Absorbance against concentration
summary: Change the extinction coefficient or the path length and say where the Beer-Lambert line goes: which way, how far, and the absorbance it reads.

spec.formula: A = ε c l, with c in mol per litre (1 µM is 10⁻⁶ M) and l in cm
spec.why: Absorbance is proportional to the extinction coefficient, the concentration and the path length (A = ε c l), so at {at} it goes from {y0} to {y1}.
spec.note: Straight only at low absorbance: stray light bends the real line down above about A = 1.5.
